LanguageData.TM_Flesh_Open: Open this raised undead's permanent flesh progression.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_StopDesc: The owner stops Feast freely; thirst and cooldown remain.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_Rage: Feast rage: bites continue until 20% thirst or the owner's stop command.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_Gate: Feast unlock requirements — maximize every skill below:
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_DevourDesc: Consume a corpse at melee range: XP depends on remaining meat and freshness. Every 5 meat reduces thirst by 1. Living organic targets: 4/6/8 damage by rank, no XP. Cooldown: 5 seconds. Successful bites on living targets also add 1% toxic buildup, reduced by toxic resistance.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_RestoreDesc: Fully heal injuries, scars and missing natural parts. Implants remain. Cost: ALL current-level XP (must be above zero). Levels and points remain. Cooldown by rank: 1000/900/800 seconds.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_EmpowerDesc: Preparation: 2 seconds; interruption costs nothing. Movement and general work speed: +10/20/30% by rank. Cost: +10 thirst. Duration and cooldown: 300 seconds. On expiry: 10% chance to injure natural limbs for 10% maximum health.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_HardenDesc: Preparation: 2 seconds; interruption costs nothing. Sharp and blunt armor: +20/35/50 percentage points by rank. Cost: +15 thirst. Duration and cooldown: 300 seconds. On expiry the torso suffers damage equal to half its maximum health.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_FeastDesc: Preparation: 5 seconds; interruption costs nothing. One rank. Requires all other skills maximized. Sets thirst to 50%; +1 thirst/second for 60 seconds. Successful melee hits: 20% chance to consume an organic part, including vital organs. Maximum thirst triggers rage; 0 thirst ends Feast. Cooldown: 1000 seconds. During Feast every melee attack is a bite; successful bites have a separate 30% chance to infect a surviving organic wound. Misses and fully absorbed hits do not trigger these effects. Successful bites on living targets also add 1% toxic buildup, reduced by toxic resistance.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_MobilityDesc: Each rank adds +2% movement speed. 10 ranks: +20% total.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_StrengthDesc: Each rank adds +3% melee damage. 10 ranks: +30% total.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_IndustryDesc: Each rank adds +2% general work speed, including crafting once. 10 ranks: +20% total.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_CapacityDesc: Each rank adds 10 maximum thirst. 8 ranks: 20 → 100. Natural thirst: +10/day. At 80%: −10% movement/work; at maximum: −20%.
LanguageData.TM_FleshRejectUnavailable: This undead must be alive, standing, under your control and not in a mental state.
LanguageData.TM_FleshRejectUnlearned: This skill has not been learned.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_ThirstTip: Accumulated hunger: +10 per day. Eating flesh reduces Thirst. At 80%: -10% movement/work; at maximum: -20%.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_HealthHarden: Sharp and blunt armor: +{0} percentage points.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_HealthFeast: Feast is active. Current Thirst: {1}/{2}. Rage persists until Thirst falls to 20% or the owner stops it.
LanguageData.TM_Flesh_BiteRules: Undead melee attacks outside Feast have a 10% chance to become critical bites (+50% damage). Successful bites add 1% toxic buildup, reduced by toxic resistance.
